title: Agent eBPF Filter outcome validation evidence
description: Reference schema for the nested features.validation object emitted by an authorized external validator. The backend also accepts documented dotted aliases; this schema intentionally describes the preferred canonical form.

validatorId.description: Stable identity of the validator used for independent-review checks.

authorizationId.description: Identifier for the approved validation scope, change ticket, CI approval, or equivalent authorization record.

runId.description: Unique or traceable ID for the disposable validation run.

candidateId.description: Preferred explicit correlation to a security-evaluation sample ID.

candidateEventId.description: Optional correlation to the original Research event ID.

findingKey.description: Optional stable root-cause key used to deduplicate actionable variants.
